style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), bright warm light, rich detail, cinematic depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third and the middle fairly simple (text sits there). The rocky valleys near ancient Makkah. Absolutely no people in any image.

scenes.s1: A quiet desert camp at night under a sky full of stars, a single tent glowing softly, peaceful. No people.
scenes.s2: A winding rocky path climbing a low mountain at dawn, soft pink and gold light. No people.
scenes.s3: A wide desert valley among bare mountains at sunrise, calm and still, light rays from the clouds. No people.
scenes.s4: Golden morning light breaking over the mountains, birds in the sky, a feeling of peace and acceptance. No people.
scenes.s5: A large beautiful white ram with great curved horns standing on rocks in radiant heavenly morning light. No people.
